name: ldar-records
description: Reconcile LDAR records for valves under EPA NSPS subpart VVa: turn component, Method 21 monitoring, calibration, repair, delay-of-repair and remonitoring exports into a leak-by-leak chronology checked against the 500 ppm leak definition and the 5-day first-attempt and 15-day repair deadlines. Check calibration and drift records behind each reading, delay-of-repair justifications, monitoring frequency and percent leaking valves, and get a missing-evidence queue. For LDAR coordinators and environmental specialists working from pasted exports.
